title: Co-Branded Card Bonus on Summit Choice-Benefit Miles
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member who holds the Crestline co-branded card receives a card bonus on a choice-benefit bonus credit. The card is shown by the companion certificate issued on a card anniversary, as its record under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter shows it.

| Card-anniversary companion certificate | Issued within the last 12 months | Card bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy | Yes | 10 percent of the selection miles |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus | Yes | 5 percent of the selection miles |
| No such certificate issued in that span | | None |

**Basis of the percent.** The percent is taken of the selection miles, which are the bonus miles per selection of the tier the member holds, and the card bonus is rounded down to the whole mile. It is added to the miles the credit carries.

**Recency.** Within the last 12 months means fewer than 12 whole calendar months from the certificate's issue date to the day the credit posts; a certificate issued on 3 July 2025 is inside the span on 2 July 2026 and outside it on 3 July 2026.

**Hypothetical figures.** On selection miles of 25000, a Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy issued six months ago adds 2500 miles, and a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin adds 1250 miles.
